# openwebui_retrieval_embedding_config (Resource)

Manages Open WebUI's embedding model settings (Admin Settings > Documents > Embedding): the embedding engine and model, batching and concurrency, and the connection settings of the Ollama, OpenAI and Azure OpenAI engines. They come from their own endpoint and are not part of `openwebui_retrieval_config`.

~> Open WebUI requires the engine and the model in every update and resets the batch size, the async toggle and the concurrency to their defaults when they are left out. This resource therefore reads the current settings, changes only the attributes set in your configuration, and sends the others back as read. Any attribute you leave out keeps its current Open WebUI value, and its state shows that value; removing an attribute from your configuration does not reset it. A connection block (`openai_config`, `ollama_config`, `azure_openai_config`) you leave out is not sent; inside a configured block, an attribute you leave out keeps its current value. The read and the write are separate requests, so an embedding change made by someone else in between is overwritten.

~> Open WebUI stores the connection blocks only while `rag_embedding_engine` is `ollama`, `openai` or `azure_openai` (all three blocks, for any of these engines) and silently ignores them for the local engine (`""`). A change to a block while the engine (after the apply) is the local one therefore fails before anything is sent. A configured block that equals the current values is accepted with any engine.

~> The connection keys are stored in Terraform state because Open WebUI returns them in plain text. Protect your state accordingly. The `url` attributes are not marked sensitive: do not embed credentials in them.

~> Every update makes Open WebUI unload and reload the embedding model. With the local engine (`""`) Open WebUI loads the sentence-transformers model into its own process: a model that is not in its cache yet is downloaded from Hugging Face inside the update request, and unless `OFFLINE_MODE` is set or `RAG_EMBEDDING_MODEL_AUTO_UPDATE` is false Open WebUI checks Hugging Face for a newer revision on every update. If the model cannot be loaded, Open WebUI still reports success, and document embedding fails until a valid model is set. The update request waits up to 10 minutes for Open WebUI to load the embedding model (unless a proxy in front of Open WebUI has a shorter timeout). If a download takes longer, the apply fails, but Open WebUI still completes the change, so re-running `terraform plan`/`terraform apply` converges. Open WebUI handles no other request while it loads a model, so other Open WebUI resources in the same apply (whose requests keep the provider's 30-second timeout) can time out meanwhile; re-running converges as well. Pre-downloading the model (for example by selecting it once in the Open WebUI admin page) avoids the wait. Changing the engine or the model does not re-embed existing documents; reindex the knowledge bases afterwards (Admin Settings > Documents > Reindex Knowledge Base Vectors). An apply that changes nothing sends nothing.

~> If Open WebUI reports a different value during an apply for an attribute you do not set (because it was changed outside Terraform after the last refresh), the apply leaves it unchanged and keeps the previous state value with a warning; the next refresh shows the server value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Only the attributes you set are changed; everything else, including
# connection keys you do not set here, keeps its current Open WebUI value.
# Every update makes Open WebUI reload the embedding model.
resource "openwebui_retrieval_embedding_config" "example" {
  rag_embedding_engine = "openai"
  rag_embedding_model  = "text-embedding-3-small"

  rag_embedding_batch_size          = 16
  enable_async_embedding            = true
  rag_embedding_concurrent_requests = 4 # 0 = unlimited

  # Stored by Open WebUI only while a remote engine (ollama, openai or
  # azure_openai) is selected.
  openai_config = {
    url = "https://api.openai.com/v1"
    key = var.openai_embedding_api_key
  }
}

variable "openai_embedding_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `azure_openai_config` (Attributes) Connection of the `azure_openai` engine (Open WebUI's `RAG_AZURE_OPENAI_BASE_URL`, `RAG_AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY` and `RAG_AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION`). Attributes left out of a configured block keep their current Open WebUI value; a block left out is not sent at all. Open WebUI stores a change to this block only while `rag_embedding_engine` is `ollama`, `openai` or `azure_openai`; with the local engine a change is refused before anything is sent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--azure_openai_config))
- `enable_async_embedding` (Boolean) Whether batches are sent to the remote engine concurrently. Used by the `ollama`, `openai` and `azure_openai` engines only. Server default: `true`.
- `ollama_config` (Attributes) Connection of the `ollama` engine (Open WebUI's `RAG_OLLAMA_BASE_URL` and `RAG_OLLAMA_API_KEY`). Attributes left out of a configured block keep their current Open WebUI value; a block left out is not sent at all. Open WebUI stores a change to this block only while `rag_embedding_engine` is `ollama`, `openai` or `azure_openai`; with the local engine a change is refused before anything is sent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ollama_config))
- `openai_config` (Attributes) Connection of the `openai` engine (Open WebUI's `RAG_OPENAI_API_BASE_URL` and `RAG_OPENAI_API_KEY`). Attributes left out of a configured block keep their current Open WebUI value; a block left out is not sent at all. Open WebUI stores a change to this block only while `rag_embedding_engine` is `ollama`, `openai` or `azure_openai`; with the local engine a change is refused before anything is sent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--openai_config))
- `rag_embedding_batch_size` (Number) Number of texts per embedding batch, at least 1. Server default: `1`.
- `rag_embedding_concurrent_requests` (Number) Maximum number of concurrent embedding requests to the remote engine while `enable_async_embedding` is on; `0` means unlimited. Used by the `ollama`, `openai` and `azure_openai` engines only. Server default: `0`.
- `rag_embedding_engine` (String) Embedding engine: `""` for the local sentence-transformers model (the server default), `ollama`, `openai` or `azure_openai`. Open WebUI fails to reload the model with any other value.
- `rag_embedding_model` (String) Embedding model: a Hugging Face sentence-transformers model name such as `sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2` (the server default) for the local engine, or the remote engine's model name, for example `text-embedding-3-small`. With the local engine a model that is not cached yet is downloaded during the apply, and `""` loads no model. Must not start or end with whitespace (Open WebUI strips it).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identifier, always `retrieval_embedding`.

<a id="nestedatt--azure_openai_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `azure_openai_config`

Optional:

- `key` (String, Sensitive) Azure OpenAI API key. Stored in Terraform state (Open WebUI returns it in plain text). Use `""` for none.
- `url` (String) Azure OpenAI endpoint, for example `https://my-resource.openai.azure.com`. Shown in plain text: do not embed credentials in it, use `key` instead.
- `version` (String) Azure OpenAI API version, for example `2024-02-01`.


<a id="nestedatt--ollama_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ollama_config`

Optional:

- `key` (String, Sensitive) API key sent to the Ollama server as a bearer token. Stored in Terraform state (Open WebUI returns it in plain text). Use `""` for none.
- `url` (String) Base URL of the Ollama server, for example `http://ollama:11434`. Shown in plain text: do not embed credentials in it, use `key` instead.


<a id="nestedatt--openai_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `openai_config`

Optional:

- `key` (String, Sensitive) API key of the OpenAI-compatible API. Stored in Terraform state (Open WebUI returns it in plain text). Use `""` for none.
- `url` (String) Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API, for example `https://api.openai.com/v1`. Shown in plain text: do not embed credentials in it, use `key` instead.
